Alger, 11 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 11, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Infinix brand announces the availability of its new smartphone, the NOTE Edge, on the Algerian market, accompanied by special launch offers.
Infinix Algérie met sur le marché son no: Infinix Algeria is launching its new model, the NOTE Edge, on the market. This smartphone stands out not only for its design, but also for additional benefits for consumers. Upon its launch, the NOTE Edge comes with an 18-month manufacturer warranty. In addition, one month of coverage is offered for screen protection in case of breakage. To mark this arrival, exclusive gifts will be distributed with each purchase during the promotional period. Infinix encourages potential buyers to visit the nearest points of sale to discover the product. This launch aims to strengthen Infinix's presence on the Algerian market with an attractive offer.
